name: limit-bars
description: Bars or rings for the 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt (weekly pace when there is no 5-hour limit), a ring showing how long the prompt cache stays warm, an optional ring for drive usage by file type, a cost ring with this chat's share of the project (from cost-ledger) and optional system values (CPU, RAM, GPU and GPU memory, live, Windows). Cache guard: asks before an expensive cold send; /cache, /handoff, /keepwarm, /disk, /bars. Every part of the display can be hidden.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

resetStyle.title: Reset display
resetStyle.description: mixed: 5h as a countdown, week as a clock time. clock: both as clock times. countdown: both as countdowns.

highlightAt.title: Highlight from (%)
highlightAt.description: From this usage on, the window tag and the percentage are bold.

style.title: Style
style.description: bar: bars for the 5-hour and weekly limits. ring: one ring per limit, like the cache ring. Rings are drawn in the desktop app only; the terminal keeps the bars. /bars style overrides this in all open chats.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5-hour bar
showFiveHour.description: Bar for the 5-hour limit. /bars overrides this in all open chats.

showWeekly.title: Show weekly bar
showWeekly.description: Bar for the weekly limit. /bars overrides this in all open chats.

showCache.title: Show cache ring
showCache.description: Ring for the prompt cache. Hiding it keeps the cold-send question and notices (/cache warn off, /cache hints off).

showStorage.title: Show storage ring
showStorage.description: Ring for drive usage. Only shown when storagePath is set; off by default because storagePath is empty.

showCost.title: Show cost ring
showCost.description: Ring with this chat's share of the project's API value, from cost-ledger. Only shown when cost-ledger is installed and has booked something. /bars overrides this in all open chats.

showSystem.title: Show system values
showSystem.description: Up to four lines: CPU, RAM, GPU load (as in Task Manager) and GPU memory (NVIDIA), each with a trend arrow, measured every second by a fixed PowerShell process while the band is drawn (Windows only). /bars overrides this in all open chats.

onlyFiveHour.title: 5-hour limit only (deprecated)
onlyFiveHour.description: Deprecated, use showWeekly. On: the weekly bar is hidden.

storagePath.title: Storage drive
storagePath.description: Drive shown as a ring next to the cache ring, for example E:. Windows only. Empty: off.
